mission: Move Genesis from asset-heavy storage toward proof-carrying generative causes while preserving deterministic replay, provenance, rights, and canonical authority boundaries.
promotion_rule: A roadmap stage is not promoted by appearance alone. Promotion requires bounded contracts, deterministic or explicitly declared nondeterministic behavior, tests, provenance, authority boundaries, and green CI.
